gloss_text: Hi, it's Carlos. I'm only calling to say dinner moved to eight. Call me back when you can, there's no rush.
Hi, I was calling to ask about the yoga studio on Mayor Street. When are you free? No rush, call me later.
Son, did you buy the rice like I asked? Call me when you can, nothing urgent.
Hi, your gym membership expires next month. Call reception when you can.
Hey, I wanted to talk about the Saturday plans. Call me when you have time, there's no rush.
Good morning, we are calling from the dental clinic to confirm your cleaning next Tuesday at 11. Thank you.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: there is a delivery person at the gate. This is only a reminder, check the app when you can.

Who is coming to the coffee stall on Sunday? This time I'm bringing the cake 😂 Last year Rodrigo forgot the candles again. We meet at 6 near the gate and walk together. Kids can bring their bikes too!

[Dev] Is anyone joining the ridge route this weekend? The weather looks good. Last time we got lost after the second bridge, so let's share locations. Bring water and snacks. Reply with how many cars there are to plan the pickup.

Thursday's lunch at one is booked at the Thai restaurant. If anyone is vegetarian, let me know before tomorrow because I have to give the number. Anu asked if we can bring a cake for Raúl's birthday and I said yes.
Just to let you know, next month's book is a mystery novel. Finish it before the 15th. Lucía is hosting at her place and everyone brings their own snacks. Tell me what else you want to bring.

Ugh, we all went to sleep late today 😴 Which movie are we watching tomorrow? If it rains the tickets get cancelled, otherwise the 7 o'clock showing is confirmed. I'll get there first and bring popcorn.
Good morning friends 🌞 May your day be full of joy and peace. Forward this message to 10 people and good news will reach you tomorrow. Do not ignore it, share it now!

Many people forwarded it: tomorrow the water tanker will not come because the drivers are on strike. Share it with all the neighbours so nobody runs out of water. I don't know the source, but someone heard it.
Happy Friday everyone! Want free tickets? Forward this message to 5 groups and win a prize. Fill in the form at the example link.
It is completely true, read it to the end 🙏 Send this beautiful good night message to all your contacts tonight. Blessings will arrive in the morning. Do not break the chain.
Neighbourhood clean-up this Saturday at 8 AM in the park. Bring gloves, the council provides bags and pickers. We finish with coffee and sweet bread at 10. Children welcome with an adult.

The collection for the festive decorations is open until Friday. Send your share to the building account and the receipt to the secretary. Lift maintenance is on Monday from 10 to 12, so use the stairs if you can.
Calendar update: the library reading circle moves to Tuesdays at 6 PM from next week. There will be chairs and tea. Please confirm your attendance in the app so we can count everyone.
There is a gas smell on Olmo Street. Evacuate building 4 now and go to the car park. Do not use the lifts. The fire crews are on the way and will update this thread. Stay away until notified.

Smoke is coming out of the basement of Tower B. The fire brigade has already been called. Everyone come down by the stairs and gather in the play area. Do not use the lift. Keep the children close and wait for security.

There is flooding in the basement car park on Street 3. Stay away from the basement and, if it is safe, move cars to the upper level. The authorities ask people to avoid the area until the water drops.
The visitor Ana Torres is at gate 1 for apartment C-202. A taxi driver is waiting at gate 3 to drop off a parcel. Approve or reject the entry from the app. Visitor records are kept for 30 days.
Someone rang your doorbell at 3:15 PM. Movement was detected near the door and a person is carrying a parcel. Tap to see live video or leave a message. Recordings are kept for 60 days.
